working_definition: "kn(+) adPNs": anterodorsal-lineage antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons (70 cells) within Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27, expressing knot (kn) but not C15, reproducing a Li et al. (2017) SMART-seq2 subcluster. Uniglomerular, projecting via iACT to mushroom body calyx and lateral horn. The report explicitly flags kn as a combinatorial transcriptomic marker of uncertain anatomical specificity.
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: An adult antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and innervate the lateral horn.

justification: No FBbt term is built on the kn (knot/collier) marker or cites Li et al. 2017 / Davie et al. 2018 for this subgroup (searched directly - no hits). The report concludes it is not established whether kn(+) adPNs is one of the six PN classes Li et al. (2017) 'unequivocally mapped' to a known glomerulus, so it should be treated as a transcriptomic subgroup of uncertain specificity rather than a confirmed single named cell type. The cluster IS-A adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (FBbt:00007438) but the distinguishing kn+ marker is not captured by any FBbt term.
recommendation: Broad-match to the adPN lineage term; do not mint a new term given unconfirmed anatomical specificity. Both flags left false per dataset guidance.
